slug: 2011-09-19 Angola Passes Personal Data Protection Law (Law 22-11)

facts.fact: The note reports that Angola's National Assembly passed Law 22/11 on Personal Data Protection on 17 June 2011, omnibus legislation covering automated and non-automated processing; it does not state promulgation or commencement.
facts.system: Lei n.º 22/11 on Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The note states that Law 22/11 establishes a Data Protection Agency with powers over international transfers and processing notifications; it does not say the body was constituted.
facts.system: Agência de Protecção de Dados (Data Protection Agency)
